name: How long does it take to repair an underground water leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair an underground water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an underground water leak repair depends on the complexity of the leak and the repair method chosen. Minor leaks that are easily accessible might be resolved within a few hours. More involved repairs, especially those requiring extensive excavation or pipe replacement, could take one to two days. Alpha-Plumbing Services aims to work efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring a lasting repair. We will provide an estimated timeline once the leak is assessed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor leaks to one to two days for complex cases, depending on accessibility and repair method.
